body: Global-rule lead returned SHIPPED. PR https://github.com/SatanshuMishra/.windful-ocean/pull/299, branch docs/scope-is-stored-not-derived, commit 9f154ab3826d33845a52498ccca610e3dbb0fba8, one file, two insertions, two deletions.U+000AU+000AThe writer read the shipped tool rather than trusting my brief, and corrected my brief in the process. I had said an omitted scope is "stored as given"; the handler at record_decision.ts:184 stores the empty string on the spine link while the result at :256 returns null. Those are two different values, so the sentence names both rather than collapsing them into a phrase that predicts neither. Landed text: "`record_decision.scope` is optional and nothing is derived for it. Supplied, it is used verbatim. Omitted, the spine link is written with an empty scope and the result reports it as `null`." Note this is more precise than the wording that landed in logbook PR 203, which says stored as an empty string and reported back as null in one clause; both are true, the global one is sharper.U+000AU+000AOne stale site, confirmed by searching the whole file for derive, derived, derivation, scope, criterion and criteria, plus a repo-wide grep finding no second copy anywhere in .windful-ocean.U+000AU+000ATWO FINDINGS ABOVE THE UNIT.U+000AU+000AFirst, the .windful-ocean suite is red on main and was already red: 949 pass, 4 fail, exit 1, all four in scripts/repo/tests/skill-router-lint.test.mjs, a census over the platform-engineer and conformance-auditor skill files failing on a missing fully-qualified plugin reference. Structurally cannot come from this change, since no test in that suite reads continuity-ledger.md and the branch differs from origin/main by that one markdown file.U+000AU+000ASecond and more serious, the repository's pre-commit gate never fires. .githooks/pre-commit contains npm test, but core.hooksPath redirects to a logbook plugin shim, which chains to a session-continuity shim, which resolves its own directory as its predecessor and exits 0. Git never looks at .githooks/ in that checkout. So every commit in .windful-ocean passes a gate that does nothing, silently, and has been doing so for an unknown period. The shim chain belongs to this project's own installer, so this is a logbook defect surfacing in another repo, not a .windful-ocean defect.U+000AU+000ASide effect on the human's working tree: the .windful-ocean checkout is now on docs/scope-is-stored-not-derived, switched off chore/relax-pr-gates, which was clean and whose PR 298 is already merged to main. Harness worktree isolation applies to the session's primary repository only, so an agent dispatched against a second repository moves that repository's real checkout.
